rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=4, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=400, outer_wall_s=3000, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, rationale=iter-2: change ONE knob img_n_bf 1->3 (image-domain BF cascade, 6->14 trainable params; proj_n_bf stays 1). FAILURE MODE (iter-1 hr=0, val_score 0.9462, PSNR 35.60 < LD-FBP 36.56): the single 6-param BF stack at Wagner-abdomen sigma defaults (img_sx=img_sy=1.5, img_sr=0.02) over-smooths on Mayo wide HU dynamic range -- design-doc warns N2I+single-kernel saturates (img sigma_x grew 0.5->1.08 in 2 ep on breast). HYPOTHESIS: a 3-deep image-domain BF cascade gives a multi-scale denoiser that removes noise while preserving attenuation edges (design-doc Hints: spend the budget on img_n_bf, proj stack is in the symmetry trap; supervised-BF needed img_n_bf=7/18 params to clear baseline hr=0.263 where 6 params did not), lifting recon above LD-FBP (hr>0). Everything else held at iter-1 (warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=400, grad_clip=1.0, lr=5e-3, proj_n_bf=1, seed=42). val_n 6->4 ONLY to bank wall headroom for the 3x deeper img stack (<=15 min target; iter-1 469s at val_n=6). Per-image N2I (commit 1f4c3394): warm-start pre-pass then per-scan Adam fit on each val scan own measurements, scored by evaluate_calibrated on L277 val. NOT amortized.
